---
name: okinos-beadle-headless
description: okinos is a headless Claude Agento beadle host; Bridge runs as a systemd user unit with pass keychain, not GNOME autostart
metadata:
  type: project
---

As of 2026-10-20, okinos (desktop, `okinos.user.home.lab`) runs beadle
identically to the pembroke laptop for identity/contacts/recipes, but Proton
Bridge is headless there.

- Bridge: `~/.config/systemd/user/protonmail-bridge.service`, enabled at boot
  (linger on), `ExecStart=/usr/lib/protonmail/bridge/proton-bridge --noninteractive`.
  Keychain helper is `pass-app` (pass store encrypted to [redacted-email] key
  `0CC4A77080715B85`). Bridge holds only the `[redacted-email]` account.
- pembroke by contrast starts Bridge via GNOME autostart with the
  `secret-service` (GNOME Keyring) helper, so it only runs during a desktop login.
- Global `~/.punt-labs/ethos/active` on okinos was switched from `jfreeman` to
  `claude` so beadle resolves claude outside repos. Previous state and the old
  unsigned recipes were moved to `~/.punt-labs/beadle/tmp/pre-sync/`.
- Recipe authorizer public key `CEE670F91FB96851` ([redacted-email]) was imported
  on okinos; the private key lives only on pembroke.
- `beadle-daemon` is NOT running on either host.

**Why:** the operator wants okinos to serve the Claude Agento mailbox without a
Wayland session.

**How to apply:** when debugging mail on okinos, check
`systemctl --user status protonmail-bridge` first, not a desktop session. Over
ssh, `~/.local/bin` is not on PATH in a non-login shell. Direct ssh from a
Claude session was denied; the operator runs `! ssh okinos...` commands.
